generated_records.full_description:
Research Associate - Drug Design (m/w/d)
Silence Therapeutics is an innovative biotechnology company with offices in Berlin, London and New Jersey. Silence develops drugs that use the body's own RNA interference (RNAi) mechanism to specifically deactivate disease-associated genes. Based on its proprietary mRNAi GOLD™ GalNAc Oligonucleotide Discovery) technology, the company develops novel drugs for diseases with high unmet medical needs.
The company's headquarters are located in London, while its research and development departments, including its research laboratories, are based in Berlin. The company currently has around 50 employees at its Berlin-Buch site.
We are seeking a
Technical Assistant or Biological Laboratory Technician (m/f/d)
for a fixed-term position of up to 2 years at our Berlin-Buch location.
In this role, you will work in the Molecular Design Department within the Drug Design team. Together with scientists and other research associates, you will perform experiments supporting the preclinical development of therapeutically active siRNAs. You will analyze and document experimental results and contribute to smooth laboratory operations.
Expected qualification and skills:
Solid experience with cell culture techniques as well as cellular and molecular biology methods (RNA isolation, qPCR)
Very good MS Office skills for data analysis and documentation
High motivation and a structured working style
Strong collaborative skills combined with the ability to work independently
Qualification as BTA, Biological Laboratory Technician (“Biologielaborant”), or B.Sc. in a life science discipline
Good command of German (B2) and English
Preferred qualifications and skills:
Protein analysis techniques (ELISA)
Experience working in 384-well and multiplex formats
Experience in method development
Experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter by 31 March 2026 to our HR department at HR@silence-therapeutics.com.
For more information, please visit www.silence-therapeutics.com.

Diversity is part of CGM!

Convinced?
Apply online now with your detailed application documents (including salary expectations and earliest possible starting date).

generated_records.full_description:
Role Description
This role is for a Data Analyst responsible for supporting data analysis, reporting, and data-driven decision-making activities. In this position, you will assist with collecting, organizing, and analyzing data to help teams understand performance, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources and support data preparation activities, including cleaning, validating, and structuring data for analysis. Your work will contribute to accurate reporting and reliable analytical outputs.
Key responsibilities include performing basic data analysis, identifying patterns and anomalies, and assisting with the creation of reports, dashboards, and visual summaries. You will help translate data into clear insights that support operational, analytical, and planning needs.
You will collaborate with analysts and cross-functional teams to understand analytical requirements and ensure data is aligned with business objectives. By organizing information and following structured analytical processes, you will help maintain consistency and quality in data outputs.
This role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow established methodologies, validate results, and support continuous improvement in data processes.
Clear communication and teamwork are essential, as you will present findings in a clear and structured manner. The Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in building reliable insights and supporting informed decision-making across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, organize, and prepare data for analysis
Clean and validate datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency
Perform basic data analysis and identify trends or patterns
Support the creation of reports, dashboards, and visual summaries
Assist in monitoring performance metrics and key indicators
Document data definitions, assumptions, and methodologies
Support data quality checks and validation processes
Collaborate with team members on analytical tasks
Maintain structured and well-organized analytical files
Support continuous improvement of data processes
Qualifications
Strong analytical and logical thinking skills
Ability to work with data and quantitative information
Familiarity with spreadsheets or basic data analysis tools
Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Ability to organize information and follow analytical processes
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
Problem-solving mindset with a structured approach
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field is preferred
